title: Knowable — The world's first Visual AI Tutor
excerpt: Knowable uses your webcam to coach you through STEM problems in real time.
content_html:
Knowable

Work it out
on paper.

Studying will never be the same again

Join For Free, Premium Upgrades Available

Now available on the Mac App Store

The world's first
visually grounded
AI tutor.

Milo gives feedback in real-time using your on-paper problem-solving progress.

Join For Free, Premium Upgrades Available

Guiding hints, never answers macOS only — uses your Mac's camera

1,000 free credits each month

Built for high school students, any subject

🍁

Made in Canada

The problem

Homework help shouldn't mean
handing over the answer

A human tutor runs about $40 an hour — and isn't there at 11pm the night before a test. Answer apps just spit out the solution, so nothing sticks. Our AI tutor follows along on paper and guides your student to figure it out themselves.

Simple setup

Up and running in
three minutes

No special equipment. No complicated setup. Just your Mac and your notebook.

1

Aim your camera at your textbook

Open Knowable on your Mac and point your built-in webcam (or your iPhone via Continuity Camera) at your textbook or notebook. No extra hardware needed.

2

Hit opt+M and ask Milo

Press and hold opt + M to speak your question, or type it in chat. Milo sees the camera frame at that exact moment.

3

Milo reads & replies

Milo writes a guiding hint in chat — with LaTeX math rendered via SwiftMath — and speaks it aloud through TTS. You find the answer yourself.

See it in action

Watch Milo coach a session

A real Knowable session: notebook on the desk, Milo following along, hints flowing as the student works.

What makes it different

Designed for how
high school students actually learn

Live coaching

Milo sees your textbook,
not just your screen

Traditional AI tutors only see what you type. Milo sees your actual textbook page through your Mac's camera. Press opt+M to ask a question by voice (or type it), and Milo answers about exactly what you're looking at.

  • opt+M push-to-talk voice + typed questions
  • Continuous camera feed via webcam or Continuity Camera
  • LaTeX-rendered math replies + spoken aloud via TTS
  • Never gives the answer — always a guiding question

Every subject

Any subject,
any textbook

Not just a math app. Milo runs on frontier vision models, so it reads diagrams, equations, handwriting, and prose across math, science, English, history, and languages — whatever your student puts in front of the camera.

  • Reads diagrams, graphs, and equations
  • Understands messy handwriting and printed prose
  • Coaches every core high-school subject
  • One app for the whole course load

For parents

Hints, not answers —
so it actually sticks

The AI isn't doing your kid's homework. Milo never writes the answer. It nudges with a guiding question so the student reaches it themselves — which is exactly why they still remember it on test day.

  • Guiding questions instead of solutions
  • Builds understanding your child keeps
  • Only responds when your student asks
  • No copy-paste answers to hand in

For everyone involved

Knowable works for you

Whether you're the one studying, the one paying for tutors, or the one teaching — Milo has something to offer.

Like having your smartest friend
in the room with you

Studying alone is tough. With Milo, you'll get quality feedback anytime you want, just a few clicks away.

Available at midnight before the exam

No scheduling, no hourly rate. Milo is there whenever you are.

Builds real understanding

Because Milo guides you to the answer, it actually sticks. Not just memorized steps.

Speaks in your language

Warm, encouraging, slightly playful. Not a robot reciting formulas.

Camera footage is never stored or shared

Common questions

Things people ask us

Is my child's data safe?

Camera frames, voice transcripts, and chat messages stream over TLS to AWS Bedrock (us-east-1), where Milo runs on foundation models. AWS contractually guarantees that your inputs and outputs are never used to train these models and are never shared with the model providers — the providers don't have access to the AWS accounts that run inference. Camera frames live only in memory during a session; they are not written to disk or to our database. Chat messages and session metadata (timestamps, event log, hint counts) are stored in our database on AWS (Amazon DynamoDB, us-east-1) — encrypted in transit and at rest — so sessions can continue across your Macs. We never share data with advertisers. See our Privacy Policy for the full breakdown.

What do I need to use Knowable?

Just a Mac running macOS Ventura or later. Knowable uses your Mac's built-in camera in Desk View mode to see your notebook — no extra hardware required. Place your notebook on your desk, open the app, and you're ready to go.

What subjects does it cover?

Every subject in your high school textbook. Milo coaches across math, science, English, history, languages, and more — anything you can put in front of the camera. Milo runs on frontier foundation models with vision capabilities, so it reads diagrams, equations, prose, and handwriting in any subject.

How much does it cost?

Knowable is free to start — every account gets 1,000 credits each month, forever. Knowable Plus is $24.99/month USD ($34.99 CAD) or $249.99/year USD ($349.99 CAD, save 17%) and includes 10,000 credits per month, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Prices shown at checkout are set by your App Store region. If you ever run low, one-time credit packs are available as in-app purchases. Credit packs never expire. Subscriptions auto-renew through your Apple ID; you can cancel any time in App Store → Settings → Subscriptions.

Does it just give answers?

No — and this is the core of what Milo does. Every hint is a guiding question designed to nudge you toward the answer, not to give it to you. Milo is built on the research principle that students learn best when they discover the answer themselves, with just enough nudging to get unstuck.

What if my child doesn't want help?

Milo only responds when you ask. Press and hold opt+M to ask a question by voice (push-to-talk — release when you're done), or type in chat. Milo doesn't volunteer interruptions; if you want to work independently, just don't ask.

blocks.html_en: Camera frames, voice transcripts, and chat messages stream over TLS to AWS Bedrock (us-east-1), where Milo runs on foundation models. AWS contractually guarantees that your inputs and outputs are never used to train these models and are never shared with the model providers — the providers don't have access to the AWS accounts that run inference. Chat messages and session metadata (timestamps, event log, hint counts) are stored in our database on AWS (Amazon DynamoDB, us-east-1) — encrypted in transit and at rest — so sessions can continue across your Macs. We never share data with advertisers. See our Privacy Policy for the full breakdown.

常见问题

人们问我们的事情

Is my child's data safe?

摄像头帧、语音记录和聊天消息通过 TLS 流式传输到 AWS Bedrock (us-east-1)，其中 Milo 在基础模型上运行。 AWS 根据合同保证您的输入和输出永远不会用于训练这些模型，也永远不会与模型提供商共享 - 提供商无权访问运行推理的 AWS 账户。 在会话期间，相机帧仅存在于内存中；它们不会写入磁盘或我们的数据库。 聊天消息和会话元数据（时间戳、事件日志、提示计数）存储在我们位于 AWS 上的数据库（Amazon DynamoDB、us-east-1）中 — 在传输过程中和静态时进行加密 — 因此会话可以在您的 Mac 上继续进行。 我们从不与广告商共享数据。 请参阅我们的隐私政策了解完整详情。

What do I need to use Knowable?

只需一台运行 macOS Ventura 或更高版本的 Mac。 Knowable 在桌面视图模式下使用 Mac 的内置摄像头来查看您的笔记本 — 无需额外的硬件。 将笔记本放在桌子上，打开应用程序，然后就可以开始了。

What subjects does it cover?

高中教科书中的每一门科目。 Milo 的教练涵盖数学、科学、英语、历史、语言等等——任何你可以放在镜头前的内容。 Milo 在具有视觉功能的前沿基础模型上运行，因此它可以读取任何主题的图表、方程、散文和手写内容。

How much does it cost?

Knowable 可以免费启动 — 每个帐户每月均可获得 1,000 个积分，永久有效。 Knowable Plus 的价格为 24.99 美元/月（34.99 加元）或 249.99 美元/年（349.99 加元，节省 17%），每月包含 10,000 个积分，新订阅者可享受 7 天免费试用。 结账时显示的价格由您的 App Store 区域设置。 如果您的积分不足，可以通过应用内购买获得一次性积分包。 积分包永不过期。 订阅通过您的 Apple ID 自动续订；您可以随时在 App Store → 设置 → 订阅中取消。

Does it just give answers?

不——这就是 Milo 所做的核心。 每个提示都是一个指导性问题，旨在推动您找到答案，而不是直接将答案提供给您。 Milo 建立在这样的研​​究原则之上：学生在自己发现答案时学得最好，只要有足够的推动就可以摆脱困境。

What if my child doesn't want help?

米洛只在你询问时才回应。 按住 opt+M 通过语音提问（即按即说 - 完成后松开），或输入聊天内容。 米洛不会主动打扰；如果你想独立工作，就不要问。
